subject: Request: tabletop summary + SOC 2 evidence mapping for suspected credential exposure
messages:
From: Alan Rivers <alan.rivers@medquant.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Unusual auth events - request for IR plan + SOC 2 evidence

Hi Stephanie / Laura,

Quick note from MedQuant security: this morning our SIEM flagged a burst of successful token exchanges for a handful of service accounts tied to your integration (see attached medquant_event_summary.csv). We're still investigating but would like to request the following to help scope:

- Your current incident response plan (playbook) and contact cadence for tabletop/real incidents.
- A mapping of SOC 2 controls to artifacts you can provide (particularly CC6/CC7 related logs, access reviews, key management).
- Any audit logs or KMS audit excerpts covering 2027-08-03 through 2027-08-09 (UTC) and a point of contact for expedited evidence transfer.

Can you confirm receipt and ETA for those items? We're treating this as a P2 and may need a short tabletop this afternoon depending on what we find.

Thanks,
Alan
Alan Rivers
Sr. InfoSec Manager — MedQuant Health
security@medquant.com

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Alan Rivers <alan.rivers@medquant.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence delivery + tabletop notes (MedQuant integration)

Alan — sharing the artifacts we discussed and a short postmortem summary of the condition we observed. See Drive folder for read-only artifacts.

What we delivered (Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqR-irp-medquant-2027):
- redwood_irp_v3.1.pdf — current IR playbook and escalation matrix.
- soc2_evidence_map.xlsx — control mapping for SOC 2 CC6/CC7 with direct links to artifacts.
- kms_audit_excerpt.log — KMS audit lines for 2027-07-20 through 2027-08-09 (redacted PII).
- token_exchange_20270803-20270809.log — token exchange records (redacted).
- change_control_summary.txt — lists service-account key rotations and approvals in the two-week pre-window.

Short summary / postmortem (initial triage):
- Timeline: we observed an elevated token-exchange rate for three service accounts between 2027-08-06 02:42 UTC and 2027-08-06 03:05 UTC.
- Impact: transactions authenticated successfully but were limited to metadata-only API calls (no data-plane retrieval observed). No evidence of bulk exfiltration in the artifacts we collected.
- Likely cause: a misconfigured CI job that re-used a service account token during a rotated secret window. Change-control summary attached; show rotation for the account on 2027-08-05 with an overlapping deploy.
- Next steps completed: revoked the affected keys, enforced short-lived tokens on the service account, and rolled a targeted configuration fix in CI (see change_control_summary.txt).

Primary evidence contact: Stephanie Nguyen (stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com). Please reply with an acknowledgement and whether MedQuant wants an expanded forensic bundle (we can provide full S3 access logs and kube audit traces under an NDA/forensic transfer ticket).

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference
